text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Fans have piled into the stands to<n>see today's big
G1 race, the Asahi<n>Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is determined to prove<n>that she's
more than Maruzensky's<n>"Successor," and will
reach the top<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With this purpose in mind, she heads<n>for the track.
